subject: What is Log_posterior parameter in rstanarm?

messages.author: d6a22ac7ce11aa1b
messages.subject: What is Log_posterior parameter in rstanarm?
parts:
Hi all,

I am working on count data where i am fitting them in rstanarm using the negative binomial function. Can I please get the meaning of the log-posterior output?

I have attached the density plot of the log-posterior output.

Thankfully,

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: What is Log_posterior parameter in rstanarm?
parts:
On Tuesday, November 8, 2016 at 10:40:09 AM UTC-5, malai...@gmail.com wrote:
I am working on count data where i am fitting them in rstanarm using the negative binomial function. Can I please get the meaning of the log-posterior output?

It isn't a parameter per se; it is the logarithm of the prior times the likelihood (up to a constant).

Ben

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: What is Log_posterior parameter in rstanarm?
